messages:
maya_pm: Quick check-in for marketplace launch readiness next Tue. Need owners for embed assets, SI cutover slots, press embargo, and localized fallbacks. Can everyone confirm? :wave:
kevin_partnerships: I can own partner asset bundle and partner communications. Will push final logos and 1-line blurb by 18:00 PT.
lucas_marketing: Marketing: need final hero image and CTA copy. Recommend staggered publish to reduce risk — landing at T, blog + press following.
olivia_pr: PR prefers simultaneous release but ok with short stagger if ops requests. I'll prepare embargo list and draft embargo note. Need partner legal signoff by 17:30 PT.
sam_engineering: Ops note: staging cutover window is 23:00000Z01:30Z night-before. Model pools require 10-20m warmup per shard. We'll run smoke at 00:30Z. Partners must provision test tenants before 22:00Z.
todd_si: SI team: we'll run webhook and OIDC handshake tests during warmup. Need API keys in the shared vault and target env name. Can someone drop keys to vault by 20:00 PT?
nina_localization: Localization: FR/DE/JA pages are at 85%. If we get final English copy by 16:00 PT we can QA and publish before landing. Otherwise we'll serve automated fallback with a language switcher banner.
maya_pm: Two blockers: hardware partner EdgeCore needs a PNG variant (they sent SVG only), and partner legal pending on one co-marketing phrase. ETA?
kevin_partnerships: EdgeCore sending PNG by 15:45 PT. Legal expects signoff by 17:00 PT. I'll escalate if delayed.
lucas_marketing: Regarding publish timing: ops recommends landing at 16:00 PT, blog at 16:30 PT, press at 17:00 PT. That staggers backend hits and keeps messaging consistent.
olivia_pr: OK locking embargo at 17:00 PT for press. Blog can go 16:30 PT. I'll notify media list with embargo details by 16:00 PT.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: marketplace-landing-v5 -> staging 2024-06-17T22:00:00Z, production tentative 2024-06-18T23:00:00Z (manual approval required).
sam_engineering: Ops ask: prepare CDN pre-warm and route flag to serve static landing if backend latency >300ms. We'll flip failed-route to static on spike.
todd_si: SI smoke test plan: 00:30Z webhook test, 00:45Z auth refresh, 01:00Z end-to-end sample provisioning. We'll post results in #incidents if any fails.
nina_localization: If any localized page fails QA, we'll add a banner and link to English page rather than leaving empty content. Plan B ready.
maya_pm: Thanks. Action items recap: kevin - assets + partner copy by 18:00 PT; olivia - embargo list by 16:00 PT; lucas - CTA + publish flags; sam - staging cutover ops; todd - SI keys/tests; nina - localized QA. Please confirm ownership by 15:30 PT. :white_check_mark:
kevin_partnerships: Confirmed.
olivia_pr: Confirmed.
lucas_marketing: Confirmed.
sam_engineering: Confirmed.
todd_si: Confirmed.
nina_localization: Confirmed, will prioritize FR/DE/JA.
maya_pm: Great — I'll send final partner comms after the 15:30 check. If anything slips, mark it urgent in this thread.
